blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—Cebuana triathlete Raven Faith Alcoseba continued her run as one of the Philippines’ most consistent top finishers in international competitions, emerging as the country’s highest-placed triathlete in the individual events of the 20th Asian Games at the Gamagori City Triathlon Venue on Sunday, September 20. The triathlete from Talisay City placed ninth in the women’s individual triathlon after clocking one hour and seven seconds, improving significantly from her 16th-place finish in the 2022 Hangzhou Asian Games. An elite swimmer for the De La Salle University (DLSU) Green Archers, Alcoseba once again led the Filipino delegation in the individual triathlon, […]...
